    # Empty string
    assert count_upper("") == 0

    # No vowels at all
    assert count_upper("BCDFG") == 0

    # Uppercase vowels at even indices: A(0), I(2), U(4)
    assert count_upper("AEIOU") == 3

    # Lowercase vowels at even indices don't count
    assert count_upper("aeiou") == 0

    # Mixed: "aBcEiO" -> even indices: a(0), c(2), i(4) -> lowercase, so 0
    assert count_upper("aBcEiO") == 0

    # Uppercase vowel at even index, non-vowel elsewhere: "EVEN" -> E(0) only
    assert count_upper("EVEN") == 1

    # Uppercase vowel at odd index doesn't count: "AE" -> A(0) yes, E(1) odd, skip
    assert count_upper("AE") == 1

    # Single uppercase vowel
    assert count_upper("A") == 1

    # Single lowercase vowel
    assert count_upper("a") == 0

    # "AbE" -> A(0) counts, E(2) counts
    assert count_upper("AbE") == 2

    print("All tests passed!")

test_count_upper()
